title: cifra.md merge conflicts
description: The conflicts of a merge whose outcome has them, as JSON (spec §11.12.5): one member, `conflicts`, an array with one object per conflict, in the order of their regions in the marked text, a `file` conflict first. Each conflict's members, and which `kind` carries which, are §11.12.5's member table (songs §11.12.1, setlists §11.13). The order of members within a conflict is a serialisation rule (§11.12.5), not validated here; the array order and the sole-conflict rule are the array's own constraints.

conflicts.description: One object per conflict, in region order, a `file` conflict first (§11.12.5).

then.description: A `file` conflict and an `unresolved` conflict are each the only conflict of their merge (§11.12.5).

Kind.description: What is in conflict: the song kinds (§11.12.1) and the setlist kinds (§11.13).

Side.description: One side of the merge: `"ours"` or `"theirs"` (§11.12.5, `deleted` and `changed`).

Unreadable.description: The sides that are not UTF-8, in the order base, ours, theirs (§11.12.5, `file`).

Line.description: The 1-based line, in the marked text, of the conflict's region's `<<<<<<< ours` line (§11.12.5).

Occurrence.description: Which of the items (or the notes block's item) with one reference, present only when more than 1 (§11.13).

Scalar.description: A side's value as a string: a value, a heading line, a voicing, a block or an item (§11.12.5).

Run.description: A side's value as a run: an array of strings, one per unit, section or line; an empty run is `[]` (§11.12.5).

LineNumber.description: An `unresolved` side: the 1-based line, after the text layer (§1.3), of that input's first marker line (§11.12.5).

Conflict.description: One conflict. The `kind` selects the branch: each branch pins the members that `kind` carries and forbids the rest (§11.12.5). The sides base/ours/theirs are optional on every kind that has them, since a side on which the thing is absent carries none (§11.12.5, a deleted-against-changed conflict).

FileConflict.description: The whole file: deleted on one side and changed on the other, or not UTF-8 (§11.12.1). No region, so no `line` and no sides.

deleted.description: Which side deleted it, for a deleted-against-changed file (§11.12.5).

unreadable.description: The sides that are not UTF-8 (§11.12.5).

UnresolvedConflict.description: The whole file: an input that holds a marker line (§11.4). No region, so no `line`; one to three numbered sides (§11.12.5).

PropertyConflict.description: One property: two values, or deleted against changed (§11.12.1). Carries `key`.

ReadingConflict.description: `notation` or `words` changed by one side under music the other wrote (§11.7.2). Carries `key` and `changed`, and `symbols` for a `notation` reading.

changed.description: The side that changed the property (§11.12.5).

symbols.description: The symbols that read differently, for a `notation` reading (§11.12.5).

ChartConflict.description: A stretch of lines in one section (§11.12.1): the runs of units, as their texts.

SectionsConflict.description: A stretch of sections (§11.8.2), or a section written whole (§11.12.2): the runs of sections, as their texts.

VoicingConflict.description: One variant in one block (§11.12.1). Carries `tuning`, `variation` and `key`.

tuning.description: The tuning as the marked text writes it (§11.12.5).

variation.description: The variation's name in the result, `""` for the default (§11.12.5).

key.description: The variant's key as the marked text writes it (§11.12.5).

VariationConflict.description: A block renamed differently by both sides (§11.12.1): the names. Carries `tuning`.

tuning.description: The tuning as the marked text writes it (§11.12.5).

BlockConflict.description: A block deleted by one side and changed by the other (§11.12.1): the blocks, as their texts. Carries `tuning` and `variation`.

tuning.description: The tuning as the marked text writes it (§11.12.5).

variation.description: The variation's name in the result, `""` for the default (§11.12.5).

BlockNotesConflict.description: A stretch of a block's notes (§11.12.1): the runs of lines. Carries `tuning` and `variation`.

tuning.description: The tuning as the marked text writes it (§11.12.5).

variation.description: The variation's name in the result, `""` for the default (§11.12.5).

ItemConflict.description: A setlist item deleted by one side and changed by the other (§11.13). Carries `item` and `occurrence` when more than 1.

item.description: The item's reference: its path as written, or its content (§11.13).

TextConflict.description: A setlist item's link text (§11.13). Carries `item` and `occurrence` when more than 1.

item.description: The item's reference: its path as written, or its content (§11.13).

EntryConflict.description: One entry of a setlist item (§11.13). Carries `item`, `key` and `occurrence` when more than 1.

item.description: The item's reference: its path as written, or its content (§11.13).

NotesConflict.description: A setlist notes block (§11.13). Carries `after`, the reference of the item it follows (with `occurrence` when more than 1), and no `after` when it is first.

after.description: The reference of the item the block follows; omitted when it is first (§11.13).
